statusDefinitions.pass: No material defect found in this limited AI inspection; not editorial certification
statusDefinitions.revise: Scope, wording or evidence linkage requires revision
statusDefinitions.reject: Confirmed material question/answer, translation or lineage defect
statusDefinitions.hold: Insufficient evidence or specialist review required

reason: Material errors in automatically accepted sample and a confirmed source-to-paper mismatch require broader screening; removing only sampled defects does not establish remaining dataset quality.
